study type: Retrospective cohort study for predictive model development
cohort: The cohort consisted of 201 very preterm infants (gestational age < 32 weeks) admitted to the Qilu Hospital of Shandong University between January 2020 and December 2023, all of whom underwent lumbar puncture.
finding: The study successfully developed and validated a personalized nomogram based on perinatal factors to predict the risk of purulent meningitis in very preterm infants.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was identified as an influencing factor in the prediction model for purulent meningitis in very preterm infants.
